comment: DVB multiprotocol encapsulation (MPE) datagram section: table id 0x3E, the section's length, the receiver's MAC
address in two parts (bytes 6 and 5, then 4 to 1), scrambling, the LLC/SNAP flag, the section numbers, then the
datagram (an IP packet, or LLC/SNAP with the flag set) and the section's CRC-32 over all of it.
Sections with the syntax indicator 0 (a checksum, not a CRC) are not read
